summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes within 25 m on all sides.

best_section.where: North kerb of Hillman Street, midway between the two corners, by the shed and garage

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 10 m (at 5 m) and 7 m (at 39 m) bracket the section; others 16-28 m away, so homes surround it.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a narrow suburban street; one parked car seen, room for a van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Low-volume local street, no through traffic seen.
drivers.convention: No signs and few parked cars; no overnight parking habit visible.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of both ends of the stretch
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the north side shade the morning, afternoon sun from the west.
